POWER MECHANICS — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. Monitor
   C. CPU
   D. Speaker

2. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

3. When learning Introduction to computer aided drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to computer aided drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to computer aided drawing.

4. When learning Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

7. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
